title: LGV Theory Test Explained: All the Parts You Need to Pass
excerpt: Multiple choice, hazard perception, and case studies if you drive professionally.
description: The LGV and HGV theory test explained: multiple-choice questions, hazard perception, Driver CPC case studies, pass marks and how to prepare.
body:
The LGV theory test is split into parts. To get your licence you need the multiple-choice and hazard perception parts, and if you'll drive professionally you also need the Driver CPC case studies.

## Multiple-choice questions

- 100 questions in 1 hour 55 minutes
- Pass mark: 85 out of 100

## Hazard perception

- 19 video clips
- Pass mark: 67 out of 100

## Driver CPC case studies

- Needed if you drive a lorry for a living
- Questions based on real-life scenarios

## How to prepare

- Study each topic, including drivers' hours, vehicle weights and loading
- Take full-length mock tests so the long multiple-choice part feels normal
- Practise hazard perception clips regularly

Your pass certificate is valid for 2 years. Check GOV.UK for current rules and fees before booking. Try a free mock test below.
